declarations.new_doc_summary: An annotation whose `transform` method rewrites the annotated definition and can add new definitions during compilation.
declarations.notes: The mixed mood 'rewrites ... and can add' is slightly asymmetric: 'rewrites' is indicative (it always does this) while 'can add' is modal (it optionally does this). A tighter phrasing such as 'rewrites the annotated definition and may introduce new definitions during compilation' would read more evenly. Not a blocker — the current wording is grammatically correct and clear.
